research_question: Whether, and to what degree, interventions can promote teacher self-efficacy in pre-service and in-service teachers, and whether the sources of self-efficacy an intervention targets (per Bandura's sociocognitive theory, e.g. mastery experiences) and other intervention features moderate the effect, synthesised by a preregistered meta-analysis of controlled or pre-post intervention studies that measured teacher self-efficacy with the Teachers' Sense of Efficacy Scale (TSES) or a comparable instrument.
inclusion_criteria: The study is an empirical primary study that implemented some form of intervention (e.g. internship, classroom-management training, coaching); purely longitudinal studies were excluded.

The sample consists mainly of pre-service teachers, teacher students, or in-service teachers for elementary, middle, high, or vocational schools; samples consisting mainly of pre-school, higher-education, or special-education teachers were excluded.
The sample size is at least 10 persons.
Teacher self-efficacy is the outcome variable.

Teacher self-efficacy was measured with the Teachers' Sense of Efficacy Scale (TSES) of Tschannen-Moran and Woolfolk Hoy (2001), or with a scale having at least one subscale comparable to one of the TSES's three subscales, in which case all items of that scale must be available.
The study provides a pre- and post-measure of teacher self-efficacy.
The study provides sufficient quantitative data to calculate the standardized mean change (M, SD, and n for the pre- and post-test); mixed-methods studies are included.
The study is written in English or German.
The study is available in full text.
exclusion_criteria: Purely longitudinal studies, or studies that did not implement any form of intervention, were excluded.
Samples consisting mainly of pre-school, higher-education, or special-education teachers were excluded.
Samples of fewer than 10 persons were excluded.
Studies that did not use teacher self-efficacy as the outcome variable were excluded.
Studies that did not use the TSES, used a scale with no subscale comparable to a TSES subscale, or for which not all items of a comparable scale were available, were excluded.
Studies that did not provide both a pre- and a post-measure of teacher self-efficacy were excluded.
Studies that did not provide sufficient quantitative data to calculate the standardized mean change (M, SD, n for pre- and post-test) were excluded.
Studies not written in English or German were excluded.
Studies not available in full text were excluded.

The article is open access (CC BY, OpenAlex W4391316815, PDF at https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.3102/00346543231221499) but that domain could not be reached from this environment on 2026-09-06 (TLS handshake failure) and the mirror copy at Technical University of Munich's mediaTUM repository (https://mediatum.ub.tum.de/1745559) exposed no direct PDF link without a JS-rendered session; the eight-item metadata string is complete on its own (wpB9-lean-brief.md section 4.1: 'Taschner_2024 eight numbered criteria with sub-parts 2a, 2b, 4a, 4b'), so no criterion text needed the full paper, but page numbers could not be attached and the authors should re-read the open-access PDF against these nine sentences before the manuscript relies on them. exclusion_criteria are negations of the paired inclusion criterion written by the protocol transcriber (source=derived, derived=true), except E1 and E2 which additionally restate exclusion wording the metadata string itself states verbatim for items 1 and 2a (see criteria_provenance; E1 is still marked derived=true because its second half, the intervention complement, is a transcriber negation). label_field = label_abstract_screening because the evaluated task is title-and-abstract screening and the cached labels.csv carries a distinct label_abstract_included column (775/3,828 positives), renamed to label_abstract_screening by fetch_synergy.py's route-plus export per wpB9-lean-brief.md section 1.1 rule 4; primary_label = label_included (109/3,828 positives, the review's final inclusion decision) per protocols/README.md's 'Choosing the primary label and label_field' section.
